MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288.

Daniel T. LeBel, Esq., appearing for Plaintiff Amber Kimple.
No appearance by defaulted defendant(s) Steven Barbarich, individually and dba Direct to Home Applicances, LLC.
Default of Defendant(s) has been duly entered.

Damages: $13,290.00
Pre-Judgment Interest: $1,704.03
Attorney's Fees: $5,100.00
Costs: $514.65
Total Judgment in the amount of $20,608.68
Judgment signed in open court.
